text: Carol Ledoux, a shy Belgian manicurist in London, cannot bear her sister Helen's married lover, his razor left in her glass, or the suitor Colin's kisses. When the couple leave for Italy, she is [alone in the flat|who_suffers|the lonely and isolated] with an uncooked rabbit rotting on the table, and [the walls begin to crack|images|the house and its rooms]. Hands reach from the plaster, a dark figure stands in the mirror, and the men who force her door meet [a candlestick and a straight razor|threat|people who kill].
